decision.summary: Two regions merit closer inspection: (1) a sharp multi-sample displacement around indices 488–495 in the overlapping window starting at 485, involving coordinated N/E drops and U rise; (2) a prolonged monotonic trend in N and E from index 605 onward, continuing through 625, with no reversal evident. Both show morphology inconsistent with ordinary noise or smooth motion.

regions.observation: Abrupt multi-sample drop in N and E components around index 490–493, with U showing a concurrent rise; the change is not fully reversed within the window, suggesting a possible permanent offset or onset of sustained motion. Surrounding samples show noisy but relatively stable behavior before and after.

Sustained monotonic increase in N (from ~5 to ~17) and E (from ~-1.3 to ~-6) across indices 605–625, with U fluctuating but trending downward; the slope appears consistent over ~20 samples, indicating persistent motion rather than transient noise. No clear return or platform observed within this span.
